patterns.statement: Round lifecycle as enum state machine in one loop
patterns.condition: a round loops indefinitely with distinct phases
patterns.action: model the round as an explicit enum state machine (Waiting, InProgress, EndGame) driven by a single server-side loop that resets state and re-enables spawners each cycle

patterns.statement: End round with race: last survivor vs timer, draw on timeout
patterns.condition: a round must end on last survivor or on a time limit
patterns.action: race a WaitForSingleSurvivor loop against Sleep(RoundDuration) so whichever finishes first ends the round; at timeout with more than one survivor declare a draw

patterns.statement: Delegate kill and survival XP to Accolade devices
patterns.condition: XP/score is awarded per kill and per survival interval
patterns.action: delegate scoring to Accolade devices fed by Elimination Manager and a Timer, and award survival XP from a snapshot of the alive list taken in a non-suspending handler

patterns.statement: A Verse manager only runs when an instance is placed in the level; check placement and editable references before playtest.
patterns.condition: a Verse creative_device exists in code
patterns.action: verify with find_actors that an instance is placed in the level and its @editable references are filled

patterns.statement: One authoritative Verse manager owns the round state machine and toggles spawners, storm and granters per phase; scoring is delegated to Accolade/Elimination Manager/Timer devices.
patterns.condition: a round-based map with infinite rounds
patterns.action: drive Waiting, InProgress and EndGame from one Verse manager that enables/disables spawners, storm and item granters per phase and resets after a delay

patterns.statement: Pre-lobby spawners plus teleport into disabled arena spawners, with a guard loop
patterns.condition: players wait between rounds while arena spawners are only positions
patterns.action: spawn players in a pre-lobby spawner group; teleport participants to disabled arena spawners at start; a 1s guard returns stray arena players to the pre-lobby

patterns.statement: Pool-first weighted drop cycle without duplicates per cycle
patterns.condition: a periodic drop gives each living player a different item from several granter pools
patterns.action: pick the pool first by weight/(served+1) plus jitter, then an unused index different from the player's last; keep granters disabled outside the round

patterns.statement: Countdown phase cancellable below minimum players
patterns.condition: a round needs a visible wait before the arena opens
patterns.action: run a countdown phase between pre-lobby and arena, cancel it if players fall under the minimum, and show the remaining seconds on the HUD

patterns.statement: Clear inventories at every phase boundary via Item Remover
patterns.condition: items from one round must not leak into the next or into the arena start
patterns.action: call an Item Remover (all items, apply to player) from Verse on participants at countdown start, right before the arena teleport, and on survivors returning to the pre-lobby

patterns.statement: Exclusive slot assignment with blocked flags and fallback
patterns.condition: participants are teleported onto a fixed set of arena positions
patterns.action: keep a per-slot blocked flag array: try the preferred slot then the next free ones, mark a slot blocked when occupied or when the teleport fails, and log duplicates

patterns.statement: Cleanup damage volume active only between rounds
patterns.condition: players build structures during a round and the area must be clean for the next one
patterns.action: enable a damage volume over the build area only while nobody is in the arena (after survivors return, disable a few seconds before the next start)

patterns.statement: Measure Item List size by probing valid indices, with manual override
patterns.condition: an Item Granter list size is unknown or may exceed a small bound, and drops must feel fair
patterns.action: probe the list at startup with GetItemGrantCountAtIndex over a wide range (up to 512), keep only valid indices, stop after a run of consecutive empty slots; allow a manual size override

patterns.statement: Guarantee a weapon on the first drop, weighted pools with anti-streak
patterns.condition: the first drop of a round decides whether players can fight at all
patterns.action: limit the first cycle to weapon pools, then draw pools by weight (about 40/30/15/15) with a per-player anti-streak never repeating a pool

patterns.statement: Pillar top as a tile aligned to pillar
patterns.condition: pillars were built from one actor and a floor tile on top must match the spawner
patterns.action: place a floor tile per pillar and re-align pillars to tiles so spawn height and footprint are consistent

patterns.statement: Log expected vs observed grant events and cumulative distribution for tuning
patterns.condition: a granter system must prove grants actually landed
patterns.action: subscribe to each granter's ItemGrantedEvent, snapshot the agents of the previous cycle and log which agents received no event, with periodic cumulative distribution percentages

patterns.statement: Measure Item Granter list size once at start with manual override and fallback
patterns.condition: item pool sizes are unknown to Verse at runtime
patterns.action: probe GetItemGrantCountAtIndex over indices at start, stop after 16 consecutive zeros, and offer a manual size override with a round-robin fallback

patterns.statement: Weighted pool-first loot with compensated anti-streak weights
patterns.condition: players must receive random loot from several Item Granter pools without streaks
patterns.action: pick a weighted pool per player excluding their last pool, and renormalize weights by fixed point to compensate the exclusion

patterns.statement: Numbered single editable fields collected into an array for MCP wiring
patterns.condition: a Verse device needs a list of many placed devices wired via MCP
patterns.action: declare numbered single @editable fields (Spawner01..12) and collect them into an array in code, because array wiring is not settable through MCP

patterns.statement: Subscribe once in OnBegin, sweep alive list instead of per-character subscriptions
patterns.condition: a manager must track players across rounds with events that fire per character
patterns.action: subscribe to events once in OnBegin (spawners, elimination manager, playspace join/leave) and validate the alive list with a periodic IsActive sweep instead of subscribing per character

patterns.statement: Per-player widget map created on join and pruned on leave
patterns.condition: each player needs a personal HUD widget with per-player counters
patterns.action: keep a map agent->widget created on join (and lazily in a guard loop), update fields server-side, and rebuild the maps without the agent in PlayerRemovedEvent

patterns.statement: Track per-player UI widgets, mappings and listeners in one helper and clear them together
patterns.condition: a UI screen needs widgets, input mappings and event listeners that must all be removed when the screen closes
patterns.action: route every AddWidget, input mapping and event subscription through one helper that records them per player, and clean up with a single ClearAllForPlayer on every exit path

patterns.statement: Trigger widget animations with a brief logic pulse and recreate the widget per visit
patterns.condition: a UMG widget animation or state must be driven from Verse
patterns.action: expose a logic field on the widget, set it true, Sleep ~0.1s so the widget notices, then set it false; build a fresh widget instance each time the screen opens

patterns.statement: Guard timed UI messages with a per-player id re-checked after each sleep
patterns.condition: a transient on-screen message (toast) can be replaced or dismissed while its timer is still running
patterns.action: give each shown message a monotonically increasing id stored per player and re-check it is still current after every Sleep before animating out or removing

patterns.statement: Lazy per-player UI object map cleaned on PlayerRemoved
patterns.condition: a per-player menu device must handle players joining and leaving
patterns.action: keep a [player]menu map created lazily on first open, subscribe PlayerAddedEvent/PlayerRemovedEvent, and on leave close the menu and rebuild the map without that player

patterns.statement: Per-player relay object carries context into event callbacks
patterns.condition: a Verse handler needs per-player context inside a Subscribe callback and local lambdas are unavailable
patterns.action: create a small relay class per player holding manager, player and agent, store it in a per-agent map and subscribe its method; keep the cancelables to cancel on leave

patterns.statement: Per-player HUD bar with retry and leave race
patterns.condition: a Verse device must show a map code or favorite prompt HUD to all players
patterns.action: attach a widget bar per player with a retry loop waiting for player UI, raced against PlayerRemoved, cycling name and favorite prompt on a timer with a minimum interval
